title: EdgeContractCapabilitiesV1
description: GET /capabilities — what this edge can do (not static table geometry).

backend_id.description: Matches coordinator backend registry id (e.g. mock.default).

runtime_sync.description: If true, edge runs SYNC_RUNTIME (RECORD + set_at_init) before advertising READY.

lan_direct_streams.description: If true, clients on same LAN may attach to stream URLs directly; coordinator still proxies by default.

supported_primitives.description: Primitive ids from the Cloud Labs inventory (e.g. MOVE_MOTOR, START_TELEOP).

measurables.description: Map of measurable_id (e.g. tag_22.camera_image) → analysis/wire/live binding.

telemetry_channels.description: Armed live channels; each binds to a measurable or tunable live samples.

requires_primitive.description: Arming primitive, typically START_LIVE_FEED or START_TELEOP.

binds_measurable.description: Measurable id when this channel is wire form of a measurable.

binds_tunables_live.description: True when channel pushes flat live samples of active tunables (TeleOp pose).

wire_profiles.description: Named JPEG/MJPEG encode profiles (replaces ad-hoc table_cam_preview knobs).
